text:
maya: Found a mysterious unlabelled paper bag in the kitchen. Who's the pastry phantom? :thinking_face:
tony: Not me. My pastries are always labelled in Comic Sans. :nerd_face: Maybe it was left by a benevolent neighbor?
alice: I left a box of mini croissants earlier but I added a green sticker. This had no sticker. 
sam: Blue-sticker muffin disappeared before lunch. Serious investigation needed. :mag: @maya any distinguishing crumbs?
maya: crumb report: cinnamon + suspicious glaze. Photo attached (imagine). :camera_with_flash:
jen: Poll time: if you find a mystery snack, do you A) Eat immediately, B) Wait to claim, C) Post in #general and hope the owner appears? React with :hamburger: / :hourglass: / :loudspeaker:
pantry-bot: FYI: Pantry label template available at /docs/kitchen/labels.md. FRIDGE CLEANOUT reminder: Friday 3pm. Use `@expiry: YYYY-MM-DD` to mark items to keep.
tony: also shoutout to @maya for starting the snack-ambassador rota last month. Plants and pastries both thriving. :seedling::croissant:
sam: One-liner attempt: "Mystery bag: the universe's way of testing our team cohesion and carb tolerance." :joy:
jen: Sam wins the one-liner crown. Claim your tiny crown emoji. :crown:
alice: Can we put a small sticky note stack by the coffee machine that says: `This is not a help desk for missing muffins`? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
maya: Snack custodian signup: reply with the week you want. I can do next week if no one else volunteers. :raised_hands:
